    toc: true

    number_sections: false

    self_contained: true
---

Panel A recreates the published network layout from PDF-derived drawing paths and labels. These coordinates are graphical assets, not a node/edge analysis table. Panel B uses the supplied topology summary. Neither panel reconstructs a network from abundance data.

Open this file in RStudio and click **Knit**, or run `rmarkdown::render("fig3/fig3.Rmd")` from the repository root. Tables are read from `data/`; PDF and PNG files are written to `plots/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE, error=FALSE,
                      fig.width=10, fig.height=6, out.width="100%", dpi=120)
ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_gray())
dir.create("plots", showWarnings=FALSE)
```

## Input files

```{r inputs, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(data.frame(File=list.files("data")), col.names="File")
```


## A. Network drawing

```{r figure3-section1}
library(grid)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
p<-read.csv("data/figure3A_paths.csv")
s<-read.csv("data/figure3A_styles.csv",na.strings=c("","NA"))
t<-read.csv("data/figure3A_labels.csv",check.names=FALSE)
paths<-split(p,p$Path)
items<-lapply(seq_len(nrow(s)),function(i){
 q<-paths[[as.character(s$Path[i])]]
 stroke<-if(is.na(s$Stroke[i])) NA else scales::alpha(s$Stroke[i],s$StrokeAlpha[i])
 fill<-if(is.na(s$Fill[i])) NA else scales::alpha(s$Fill[i],s$FillAlpha[i])
 gp<-gpar(col=stroke,fill=fill,lwd=max(.05,s$Width[i])*96/72,lineend="round",linejoin="round")
 if(!is.na(fill)) polygonGrob(q$X/510.236,1-q$Y/270,gp=gp) else polylineGrob(q$X/510.236,1-q$Y/270,gp=gp)
})
labels<-lapply(seq_len(nrow(t)),function(i) textGrob(t$Text[i],x=t$X[i]/510.236,y=1-t$Y[i]/270,just=c("left","bottom"),gp=gpar(fontsize=t$Size[i],col=t$Color[i],fontface=t$Face[i],fontfamily="Arial")))
bar<-lapply(1:100,function(i) rectGrob(x=.86+(i-.5)*.0012,y=.55,width=.0013,height=.009,gp=gpar(col=NA,fill=colorRampPalette(c("#DCEAF5","#0066A2"))(100)[i])))
network_grob<-gTree(children=do.call(gList,c(items,bar,labels)))
dir.create("plots",showWarnings=FALSE)
pA<-wrap_elements(full=network_grob)
ggsave("plots/figure3A.pdf",pA,width=180,height=90,units="mm",device=cairo_pdf,bg="white")
ggsave("plots/figure3A.png",pA,width=180,height=90,units="mm",device=ragg::agg_png,dpi=300,bg="white")
```


```{r figure3-preview1, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(c("plots/figure3A.png"))
```


## B. Network topology

```{r figure3-section2}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
d<-read.csv("data/figure3B_topology.csv")
colours<-c(BM1="#A51C36",BM2="#7ABBDB",BM3="#84BA42",BM4="#682487",FM1="#DBB428",FM2="#D4562E")
d$Group<-factor(d$Group,levels=c("W/O Infection","W/ Infection"),labels=c("w/o","w/"))
d$Time<-as.integer(sub("T","",d$Timepoint))
metrics<-c("assortativity","avg_degree","avg_path_length","density","diameter","edge_count","node_count","transitivity")
one<-function(metric,kingdom){
 x<-d[d$Metric==metric & d$Kingdom==kingdom,]
 ggplot(x,aes(Time,Value,colour=Module,linetype=Group,group=interaction(Module,Group)))+
 geom_line(linewidth=.35,na.rm=TRUE)+geom_point(size=1,na.rm=TRUE)+
 scale_colour_manual(values=colours,drop=FALSE)+scale_linetype_manual(values=c("w/o"="dashed","w/"="solid"))+
 scale_x_continuous(breaks=0:3,labels=paste0("T",0:3))+
 labs(x=NULL,y=x$MetricLabel[1],title=kingdom)+theme_classic(base_size=7)+
 theme(panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA,linewidth=.35),axis.line=element_blank(),panel.grid=element_blank(),plot.title=element_text(size=8))
}
rows<-lapply(seq_len(4),function(i) wrap_plots(one(metrics[i],"Bacteria"),one(metrics[i],"Fungi"),one(metrics[i+4],"Bacteria"),one(metrics[i+4],"Fungi"),nrow=1))
pB<-wrap_plots(rows,ncol=1,guides="collect")+plot_annotation(title="Network metrics over time by CAMs")
dir.create("plots",showWarnings=FALSE)
ggsave("plots/figure3B.pdf",pB,width=200,height=120,units="mm",device=cairo_pdf)
ggsave("plots/figure3B.png",pB,width=200,height=120,units="mm",device=ragg::agg_png,dpi=300)
```


```{r figure3-preview2, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(c("plots/figure3B.png"))
```


## Figure assembly

ggsave("plots/figure3.pdf",p,width=200,height=215,units="mm",device=cairo_pdf,bg="white")
